title: 150 Years of Heidelberg Materials
content: # 150 Years of Heidelberg Materials. New Heidelberg Portland-Cement plant in Leimen, 1900. This account of the 150-year history of Heidelberg Materials traces the origins of the company. Developed in Great Britain, Portland cement also became a sought-after product in the German Confederation and later in the German Empire. In the middle of the Gründerzeit, in 1873, the trained beer brewer Johann Philipp Schifferdecker built a Portland cement plant in Heidelberg, which operated under the name "Portland-Cement-Werk Heidelberg, Schifferdecker & Söhne". As the city of Heidelberg prevented the rebuilding of the plant due to the dirt and noise pollution, the largest Portland cement plant in the German Empire was built in neighbouring Leimen. Otto was killed in the First World War, Ehrhart was plant manager in Leimen, a member of the board of directors and led the company after the Second World War. The company quickly developed into the leading group in southern Germany.

Overview:
Heidelberg Materials is one of the world's largest integrated manufacturers of heavy building materials and solutions with leading market positions in cement, aggregates, and ready-mixed concrete. Around 49,000 employees in almost 50 countries shape our growth path. Drawing on our global advantage, we create synergies in the areas of sustainability, digitalisation, and technical excellence. As the industry’s front runner on the path to Net Zero, we enable our customers to lead the way towards a more sustainable future through our growing offering of low-carbon and circular building materials.

title: Company Leadership Team - Heidelberg Materials
content: Chris Ward is President and CEO of Heidelberg Materials North America. He has been with the company since 1996 and most recently served as President of the company’s Canada Region. Ward has also held management positions in Georgia, North Carolina and Texas. He has been with the company since 2012 and has held a variety of senior management roles. Previously, he served as Vice President of Finance for the company’s South Region. Oliver Patsch is President of Heidelberg Materials North America's Northwest Region. Matteo Rozzanigo is President of Heidelberg Materials North America's Northeast Region. Prior to his current role, he served as Senior Vice President and General Manager Materials for the company’s Northeast Region. He has been with the company since 2001 and has held a number of management positions in North America, including Senior Vice President & General Manager of Northeast Materials, Vice President & General Manager of the New York Materials business and a variety of operations management and continuous improvement roles.
